objective: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

description: The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.
<name>, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
progress: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
completion: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. <name>, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
For your efforts, I reward you with a choice of my prized possessions.
